quotes: PortalStore.begin: [RETURN_SHAPE] MUST open exactly one SQLite connection for the supplied database_url, call create_audit_schema, create_project_tracking_schema, create_project_section_schema, create_budget_schema, create_snapshot_import_schema, create_expense_schema, create_progress_photo_schema, create_staff_access_schema, create_client_access_schema, and create_producer_identity_schema on that same connection, and return a new open PortalTransaction owning it; a failure MUST close the new connection and raise PersistenceError, and no active transaction may be shared implicitly. The connection installs no row factory, so every query returns a positional tuple row and a repository decodes a column by its position in the table's declared column order; reading a column by name raises TypeError against this connection and MUST NOT be emitted.

The connection installs no row factory, so every query returns a positional tuple row and a repository decodes a column by its position in the table's declared column order; reading a column by name raises TypeError against this connection and MUST NOT be emitted.
precedent.why: State 7 explicitly requires PortalStore.begin itself to call all ten repository schema functions on its owned connection, so the generated implementation does not need to guess.
